fact: Law 18-07 as amended by Law 25-11 of 24 July 2025 is in force, creates the ANPDP with the task of ensuring ICT use poses no risk to rights, and limits decisions taken solely on automated processing; it is a data-protection law, not an AI law.
title: القانون 07-18 المعدل والمتمم بالقانون 11-25
publisher: السلطة الوطنية لحماية المعطيات ذات الطابع الشخصي
